scope: three different GOs samples (at 0.5 mg/mL) were incubated with 10% human serum in PBS for 1 h at 37 °C under continuous stirring. After the incubation, the GOs/protein complexes were separated from the serum by centrifugation at 21,600g for 15 min at 4 °C.

To elute corona proteins from the GOs samples, 100 µL of 5% SDS was added to the GOs/corona complexes, and the mixture was heated at 95 °C for 15 min. Finally, the samples were centrifuged at 10,600g for 15 min and digested for label-free LC-MS/MS analysis.
